text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало drags me along to practice
her peculiar
call and response routine:
"What's my name?"
"Кинг Хало!" A bit
shameless, but at least she's in
great
form.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Her next stunt involves organizing a
press
interview during a training session.
However, a
disapproving Эйр Грув
puts a stop to it and
challenges King's
actions.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Like Кинг Хало, Эйр Грув is the
daughter of a
famous racer. She
attempts to share some advice,
but King
Halo isn't in the mood to hear it.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало remains bent on gaining the

recognition of the public—who regards
her as
little more than her mother's
daughter—and of
her mother herself,
who refuses to acknowledge
her
daughter's talent.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
